xinjianxue-skill-parenting-qa-global v1.0.0

- Initial release of the "Parent–Child Relationship Advisor" skill package for XinJianXue.
- Provides parent–child relationship analysis and guidance, focusing on both perspectives.
- Requires explicit user consent and onboarding with a business license and authorization code.
- Outlines specific activation criteria and non-activation cases to ensure proper usage.
- Integrates with XinJianXue API for reports, billing, and authentication via dual credentials.
